brief:
Israeli military forces conducted airstrikes and demolished homes across southern Lebanon on Thursday, the Shehab Wire reported. The operations included burning residential structures in the region, marking a continuation of violations against the ceasefire agreement between the two sides. Israeli occupation forces executed the demolition and arson operations during morning hours, according to the Lebanese news agency.

The raids represent ongoing breaches of the truce terms. The incidents add to a pattern of alleged Israeli violations since the ceasefire took effect, as tensions remain high along the border region.
